# WO-2026-08-12-06 — Terra has the glasses. Fix the three things that are ours.

## Acceptance criteria

> **⛔ WARWICK'S RULING, AND IT CLOSES THE VISION QUESTION.** *"This is the point to stop treating vision as
> an open research problem... Terra can now SEE the whole list reliably with the current image-prep process.
> **The glasses work.** Do NOT redesign the vision architecture again. Do NOT start another model experiment.
> Do NOT go back to prompt whack-a-mole. Do NOT describe this as a coverage problem anymore... **TERRA HAS
> THE GLASSES. The remaining failures are ours.**"*
> **Three bounded defects, plus the instrument. Nothing else.**

**AC1 — DETERMINISTIC OVERLAP RECONCILIATION.** The four recurring sites are the same physical handwritten
lines seen from adjacent overlapping bands — corned beef (5+6), Febreze (5+6), sultana cake (6+7), crisps
(7+8) — every one `cross_region` at a boundary, in **3/3** runs.

**The invariant, in Warwick's words:**
> **SAME PHYSICAL SOURCE LINE seen from overlapping regions → ONE retained observation.**
> **TWO DIFFERENT SOURCE LINES, even if semantically similar → TWO purchases.**

⛔ **Do NOT reconcile by:** fuzzy product-name similarity alone · catalogue identity alone · model confidence
· *"these look close enough"*. **Use application-owned region geometry and source-line evidence.**

**Why the second half is load-bearing and not theoretical:** WP-B15-31 caught reconciliation absorbing
**Yazoo strawberry into Yazoo chocolate, Twix ice cream into Twix biscuit bars, and Arla milk into ASDA
milk** — three separate purchases Warwick asked for, silently merged. **A fix that collapses the four
recurring duplicates but re-merges those is a worse outcome than today.** Pin both directions.

**AC2 — EXPLICIT COUNT ACCURACY ON THE INFORMATIVE SET.**

⛔ **The denominator is 12, not 39.** 27 of 39 lines have a true count of 1, where a lost count and a read
count give the identical answer. Current real performance: **9/12, 9/12, 10/12.** Warwick: *"That is not
acceptable yet."*

**The failure class is now narrow: the count ARRIVES and a few digits are misread, repeatedly.** Pages **11
(`4`→`1`)**, **16 (`3`→`2`)** and **19 (`1`→`2`)** recur identically in 3/3 runs. **Characterise those
exact visual conditions** — what is different about those three marks — **and fix the narrow upstream
extraction seam.**

⛔ **Do NOT weaken the deterministic default-one rule. Do NOT turn product-pack numbers back into
quantities.** The invariant is unchanged: **explicit count on page → preserve it ACCURATELY. No explicit
count → household default 1 retail unit.**

**AC3 — THE VISUAL-EVIDENCE GATE. Structural, not a prompt rule.** This is the most important grounding
defect remaining.

Milky Way, TRESemme and Walls sausage rolls are **valid catalogue products that are NOT on the photograph.**
**The closed enum successfully killed arbitrary brand invention — but household context is still gaining
authority to MANUFACTURE PHOTO truth.**

**The invariant:**
> **A PHOTO-derived item may become durable PHOTO truth ONLY if it has supporting visual evidence from an
> actual application-owned source region.**

Household catalogue / Regulars / Favourites / aliases **may** answer *"which known product does this visible
handwritten line mean?"* They **may NOT** answer *"what additional products probably belong on this
photograph?"*

**No supporting source-line evidence → the item cannot enter PHOTO provenance. UNKNOWN is valid. Inventing
is not. Guessing another catalogue item is not.**

⛔ Warwick: *"This is NOT a prompt politeness rule. **Enforce it structurally in the acceptance/reconciliation
path.**"* A prompt instruction that asks the model to behave is **not** a discharge of this AC.
*(Note: migration 020 already enforces `provenance = PHOTO` IFF `source_region_id IS NOT NULL` at the
database level. What is missing is the application gate BEFORE a line is offered for persistence. Do not
build schema work.)*

**AC4 — FIX THE INSTRUMENT. Warwick's five families, exactly.** *"The current metrics have repeatedly lied
by omission."*

- **PHOTO COVERAGE** — expected 39 · detected · omitted.
- **PHOTO INVENTION** — **catalogue-valid but unsupported PHOTO additions** · **arbitrary out-of-set
  invention**. *(These are different failures and have been reported as one.)*
- **DUPLICATES** — raw overlapping observations · **correctly reconciled same-line duplicates** ·
  **incorrect cross-line merges**. *(All three; today "duplicates" conflates sites with survivors.)*
- **QUANTITY** — explicit-count lines **total** · explicit counts **preserved** · explicit counts
  **correct** · default-one lines · **product-pack digits ignored as quantity**.
- **IDENTITY** — correct · wrong · unresolved.

⛔ *"Do not report 'quantity errors 3/39' when only 12 lines can actually expose the defect."*
**Also fix the two limits you yourself reported:** `leadingCountPreserved` measures *availability* not
*correctness* and is blind to the pages 11/16/19 class — it must now distinguish **preserved** from
**correct**; and every rate must carry its denominator.

**AC5 — DO NOT REGRESS THE EYESIGHT ARCHITECTURE. Regression-protected territory, Warwick's list:**
orientation/reading-axis correction · application-owned regions · **actual 3× enlargement** · individual
region inspection · household context retained · strict closed candidate set · UNKNOWN allowed · explicit
quantity field · source truth separated from catalogue identity. **Pin these; the next work is downstream
correctness, not another vision design.**

**AC6 — FREEZE, THEN RE-PROVE ON MULTIPLE RUNS.** Warwick: *"freeze the implementation and rerun the SAME
known photograph **multiple times**."* **Minimum three, and the same freeze discipline as WP-B15-32 applies:
prove the runs identical (HEAD unmoved, no tracked file modified, byte-identical invocation, catalogue array
identical) and change NOTHING between them, including anything a run exposes.**

**The target, Warwick's, and it must hold across ALL runs rather than the best one:**
**39/39 detection · 0 omissions · 0 unsupported PHOTO inventions · 0 incorrect duplicate merges · 0 explicit
quantity errors on the 12 informative count-bearing lines · catalogue identity correct or explicit UNKNOWN.**
*"A genuine uncertain line may go to Cockpit. **A silently wrong line may not.**"*

**AC7 — mutation-prove the deterministic invariants.** At minimum: force two observations of one source line
and show they collapse to one · force two genuinely different source lines with near-identical names and show
they do **not** merge · offer a catalogue item with no source-region evidence and show it is **refused** PHOTO
provenance. **A gate no test can fail is not a gate.**

**AC8 — PROJECT THE COST BEFORE THE FIRST RUN, then measure.** Ceiling **$2.00**. Basis: the three variance
runs cost $0.3674 / $0.3212 / $0.3326. **State the projection on the record before spending, and report
actual against it.** If it lands above, say so and continue — the runs are the deliverable.

⛔ **NO ACCEPTANCE IS CLAIMED BY THIS ORDER**, whatever the numbers say. Warwick: *"Until then, no claim that
AsdAIr is accepted."* The live proof is a fresh production photograph, which comes AFTER convergence and the
gates and is not in this order.

## Required evidence

- Both suites, executed, asserting **reported counts** and naming them. Baselines at `e087de5`: package **920 / 917 pass / 0 fail / 3 skipped**; prototype **218 / 218 / 0 / 0**. Report the new counts; the package figure **must not regress**.
- **AC7 mutation proofs, all three, each shown to FAIL when the guard is removed**: same-line collapse · different-lines-never-merge · no-evidence-no-PHOTO.
- **AC6 freeze proof**: HEAD and `git status --porcelain` before run 1 and after the last run · SHA unmoved · `git diff HEAD --stat` empty at both points · identical invocation · catalogue array byte-identical across all artefacts.
- **Every run reported SEPARATELY** in the five metric families, with calls / wall time / cost. **No mean substituted for the runs.**
- `bash scripts/secret-scan.sh --surface services/asdair/pipeline/agenticVisionPrototype` → exit code AND coverage; this narrower form is the **accepted coverage** (Amendment 1 of WO-2026-08-12-05). The wide `--surface services/asdair/pipeline` form exits **1** on four hits **all inside the gitignored vendor tree** — report it, it is a known order-side defect, not a finding.
- `bash scripts/secret-scan.sh --surface services/asdair/pipeline` → report exit code AND coverage. Exit 2 is NOT SCANNED, never a pass

## Inputs supplied

- `Deliverables/2026-08-04-build-015-asdair-wayfinder-plan.md` § **⟦ACTIVE SESSION WORK PACKAGE⟧** — Warwick's post-variance directive in full, and § "THE VARIANCE RESULT" with the four answers. **The authority and the evidence base for this order.**
- **Your own branch at `e087de5`** — the three variance artefacts under `runs/` (`…22-18-47…`, `…22-21-44…`, `…22-24-48…`), each with full two-layer score, raw lines, per-band detail, reconciliation and the recorded catalogue. **These name the exact recurring sites, pages and phantom products this order must fix.**
- `agenticVisionPrototype/` — `twoLayerScore.js` (AC4), `groundLines.js` and the reconciliation path (AC1, AC3), `lineSchema.js` and `quantityRule.js` (AC2), `fixtures/photo39.fixture.json` (the instrument, verified coherent in WP-B15-32's AC1).
- `services/asdair/pipeline/imagePrep.js` — canonical orientation-aware planner; `bandPlan.js` is a pure re-export. **AC5 territory: do not change the geometry, only how overlaps are RECONCILED.**
- `services/asdair/db/020_shop_line_provenance_and_human_state.sql` — the database already enforces `PHOTO ⟺ source_region_id NOT NULL`. **Read it for the shape AC3's application gate should mirror. Do not write schema.**
- The real household catalogue via `loadCatalogue.js`, household ID **1**, **109 active regulars**.
- **The photograph** — the only private-surface input, read-only.

## Explicitly out of scope — report, never fix

- ⛔ **THE VISION ARCHITECTURE.** No redesign, no model experiment, no prompt round, no region-geometry change. Warwick has closed this by name: *"The next work is downstream correctness, not another vision design."* **If you are editing how the page is seen, you have left the order.**
- ⛔ **Weakening the default-one rule, or letting pack-size digits become quantities.** Both invariants are unchanged.
- **Any database WRITE**, migration or DDL. SELECT-only. **Four-way provenance PERSISTENCE stays out** — AC3 is the application gate that decides what would be *eligible*, not the write path.
- **Converging branches, opening a PR, merging, or any gate dispatch.** Warwick sequences that AFTER this bar is met; it is Larry's to run.
- **Claiming acceptance, end-to-end, or live proof.** No production photograph event is exercised here.
- **`abAcceptanceHarness.js`'s 41-line trolley** · **`applyVisionConfidenceGate`'s `Number(null)===0`** · **the secret scanner's vendor-tree blindness** · **GL-012 shape divergence** · **`deps.js`'s `realInterpretPhoto` having no executed test** · **`visionAgenticTurn` resolving through `FUSION_MODEL_ANSWER` rather than `FUSION_MODEL_VISION`** (your LOW finding — real, worth knowing, not this order's). All REPORT-ONLY.

## Sequencing

**0. READ-BACK, then HOLD.** **Five consecutive read-backs on this build have found genuine defects in
Larry's orders and all five were upheld in full** — including one showing the ordered region geometry would
have made the result worse, one showing the quoted baseline was stale-instrument output, and one showing two
premises of the last order were confounded. **It has been the single most valuable control in this build.**
Apply the same scrutiny. The envelope-table/frontmatter divergence is **pre-answered in `contract_conflicts`
— note it if you like, but do not hold on it.**

**1. AC4 — fix the instrument FIRST.** Every other AC is graded by it, and it has *"repeatedly lied by
omission"*. Re-score the three existing variance artefacts with the corrected instrument so the before/after
is legible on identical raw data, and **retain the superseded blocks** as you did last time.

**2. AC1 → AC3** — the two structural gates, both pinned by AC7 mutation proofs **before** any run.
**AC1 must hold in BOTH directions** — collapse the four recurring sites AND keep Yazoo/Twix/milk separate.

**3. AC2** — characterise pages 11, 16 and 19, then fix the narrow extraction seam.

**4. AC5** — pin the eyesight architecture so a regression fails a suite rather than surfacing in a
percentage.

**5. AC8 projection → AC6 freeze → three or more runs, nothing changed between them**, each reported
separately in the five families.

**Git endpoint: COMMIT and PUSH the branch** — `git push origin HEAD:build-015/b15-28-agentic-vision-prototype-v2`.
**NO PR.** Work from `e087de5`; do not merge `main`.

**Return to Larry** with: the corrected instrument and the re-scored variance artefacts, the three mutation
proofs, each run reported separately in the five metric families, the freeze proof, cost projected vs actual,
everything on the report-only list, and your HEAD SHA. **If the target is not met, say so plainly with the
evidence — that discharges the order.** Do not iterate toward a number.

## C1 UPHELD — **AC1's premise was FALSE. It is RETARGETED.**

The four named sites are **already collapsed, 3/3, with `accounting.closes: true`**. `reconcileAcrossBands`
(`bandInspection.js:211`) already implements the ordered invariant, **and the identity veto already exists**
(`:253–259`, added by WP-B15-31 with the Yazoo / Twix / Arla incidents written into its comment as rationale).
**Larry read "sites 5/5/6, survivors 5/3/2" and concluded the four recurring sites were not being collapsed.
They were. The survivors are a different set.** AC1 as written was close to a no-op plus tests over
already-correct behaviour.

**AC1 IS RETARGETED to the real defect you found:**

**(a) `needs_human` is never cleared after reconciliation resolves the pair.** `markDuplicates` runs inside
`groundLines` **before** reconciliation and stamps `duplicate_collision: true, needs_human: true` on every
cross-region member; reconciliation then merges the pair and **nothing revisits the flag**. So the four
correctly-collapsed sites survive as **one line each that still demands a human.** Fix that — it is small,
in-scope and it is what "duplicates" in the reporting actually meant.

**(b) The residual non-adjacent duplicates are AC3's territory, not AC1's — and you are right.** Page 1
(Arla milk) appears in regions **2 (`L0–R100`) and 8 (`L480–R576`)**, which share no pixels. **By
application-owned geometry those cannot be one physical line, and the adjacency rule is CORRECT to refuse
them.** That is a line appearing where there is no visual evidence for it — a grounding failure. **Hand it
to AC3.**

**AC7's mutation proofs stand unchanged**, and are now proofs that existing behaviour cannot silently
regress rather than proofs of new work. Keep both directions.

## C2 UPHELD — **AC2 is RETARGETED to "no SILENTLY wrong count".**

You have established that the model's `leading_mark` is wrong **at source**, identically 3/3 — page 11 `4`→
`"1"`, page 16 `3`→`"2"`, page 19 `1`→`"2"` — and that **the application-side quantity rule is correct in
every one of those cases**: it receives a mark, believes the page over the model's own `quantity`, and
resolves faithfully to a wrong digit. **There is no downstream extraction seam left to fix. Warwick's AC2 as
scoped is unachievable, and saying so is the correct return.**

**RETARGETED, using Warwick's own bar:** *"A genuine uncertain line may go to Cockpit. **A silently wrong
line may not.**"* Detect **cross-observation disagreement in `leading_mark` on one reconciled physical line**
and route it to `needs_human` rather than silently believing one side.

⛔ **Report the coverage honestly and do not oversell it:** on the existing artefacts this catches page 16 in
runs 1 and 3; it does **not** catch page 19 (single observation) or page 11 in runs 2–3. **A single wrong
observation with nothing to disagree with it remains undetectable by this mechanism.**

## C6 — **AUTHORISED. Add the transcription-only positional field. This is Larry's ruling and it is reported to Warwick as such.**

You flagged the lever and correctly declined to pull it. **Pull it.**

**Why this is NOT what Warwick forbade:** he ruled out *redesigning the vision architecture*, *another model
experiment*, and *prompt whack-a-mole*. **A transcription-only positional field is none of those.** Regions,
reading axis, 3× enlargement, individual band inspection, the closed enum, UNKNOWN and the explicit quantity
field are all **untouched**. It is the **same pattern as `leading_mark`**, which Warwick accepted and which
moved count preservation 46.2% → 89.5%.

**Why it is necessary rather than nice:** you have established in C5 that AC3 has **no available structural
signal** — the phantoms carry a valid `source_region`, non-empty `as_written` and an in-enum `product_id`,
so they pass every existing gate — and that the only application-owned alternative, the geometric line
budget, is **per-band not per-line** and strong enough to reject a real line. **Warwick's §3 demands
structural enforcement. Without a per-line positional signal it cannot be built. The field is the mechanism
his own directive requires.**

**Bound it tightly:** transcription-only, position **within the band**, no bearing on identity, quantity or
the candidate set; it informs **application-side** decisions only. **It must never become a reason to accept
a line** — only a reason to withhold one.
